title: Data Exfiltration & Incident Reconstruction
story: Black Falcon Bank has confirmed that the compromised application server communicated with unauthorized external infrastructure. Management requires the SOC to determine whether sensitive data left the environment and reconstruct the incident from initial reconnaissance through exfiltration.
objective: Reconstruct the Medium-level incident from initial access through data exfiltration. Correlate the evidence in this case with findings from BF-M-001 through BF-M-004 to identify the original attacker, initial access, persistence and final exfiltration activity.

questions.label: Which internal host performed the data exfiltration?
What archive was created before exfiltration?
Which protocol/method was used to exfiltrate the archive?
How did the attacker first obtain authenticated access?
